verdict.delta_sentence: Compared with the nearer intent-classification-2 reference, this board offers stronger tinted grouping and semantic color but loses finish through larger dead frame areas, several marathon feedback routes, and visible junction/termination artifacts.

sub_checks.name: frame_use
sub_checks.note: The two-row workflow is broadly balanced, but the large empty band below the control panels and unused space at the right leave a substantial portion of the locked frame visually dead.

sub_checks.name: corridors_and_air
sub_checks.note: Nodes and label chips generally have ample breathing room, with clear gaps between stages, though the central long feedback corridors consume air without adding useful visual structure.

sub_checks.name: grouping
sub_checks.note: Ten lightly tinted, clearly titled regions perform real grouping work, and the two-node section rhythm makes the main lifecycle easy to scan.

sub_checks.name: color
sub_checks.note: Section hues and green, red, orange, and magenta flow semantics are mostly consistent, although the large number of pastel families creates slightly more decorative variation than necessary.

sub_checks.name: machinery_leakage
sub_checks.note: Failure: a star-like junction appears on the dashed magenta stale-check route, while the telemetry connector ends in a conspicuous bracket-like stub and the long red restart route has an awkward terminal bend.

sub_checks.name: alignment_and_rhythm
sub_checks.note: The four-by-two main-stage grid holds strong horizontal and vertical registers, but the lower control panels sit off that primary rhythm and make the composition feel appended rather than fully integrated.

sub_checks.name: edge_legibility
sub_checks.note: Failure: most local arrows are clean, but the located-findings, fresh-run, and future-threshold feedback paths make long cross-board detours whose bends and distant labels weaken immediate traceability.

verdict.rank_order_sanity_note: The visual ordering and assigned scores agree: gc-decomp-harness ranks first at 7.5, intent-classification-2 second at 7.0, and the board under grade third at 6.5.
